rows: Mean CFO / net profit 188% over 5 years
4 FLAG / 2 WATCH across 16 accounting tests; LojikX™ Consistency Score 57/100

sections.heading: Flagged items in detail
paragraphs: Current Ratio Liquidity: Current assets cover current liabilities 0.65 times. Liquidity is tight relative to short-term obligations.
Share Dilution Check: The share count changed +18.9% a year. Dilution transfers value from existing holders to new issuance.
ROE vs. ROCE Quality: Return on capital employed of 10.0% with ROE of 10.6% is close to or below the cost of capital, so growth destroys rather than creates value.
CapEx Intensity Check: Capital expenditure averaged 20.4% of revenue. Capex intensity is unusual for the business model and needs a return check.
Working Capital Cycle (DSO / DIO): The cash conversion cycle absorbs 63 days of working capital. A long cycle ties up cash and makes growth expensive to fund.
Book Value Compounding: Book value per share compounded -12.7% annually. Retained earnings are not translating into balance-sheet growth.

Auditor & Governance Cleanliness: Aggregating the accounting evidence: 4 hard red flags and 2 watch items, with a LojikX™ Consistency Score of 57/100. The pattern of flags warrants a closer read of the auditor notes and related-party disclosures.
